recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If a current implementation guide still has a broken collapsed menu, handle it against the active IG Publisher/template repository or the affected IG rather than reopening this stale FHIR-core source task.
issue_request: FHIR-12497 reported that demo implementation guides, specifically the Healthedata1 Argo-DSTU2 build, had a non-functional collapsed hamburger menu. The issue is Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification and the recorded direction was to fix it if it was fixed in the main build.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed source commit for FHIR-12497 was found in the current FHIR checkout. The relevant Zulip thread records that Eric Haas fixed the hamburger-menu behavior in May 2017 in Healthedata1/IG-Template by moving Bootstrap/JQuery script tags to footer.html, and the Jira comment trail later says it looked fine and to file a more specific task if not.
additional_context: Current FHIR core source does not actively own the historical Healthedata1 Argo-DSTU2 demo IG. source/fhir.ini only lists HL7/fhir-testing-ig in the active additional IG list, source/packages.html documents IG-Template as a tool package type, and git history shows the old in-repo IG publisher/test IG fixtures were removed in 2019 because the IG publisher moved to Maven. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source files were changed because the available evidence shows the historical issue was already handled outside current core source and there is no current build-scope artifact that should be patched for FHIR-12497.
